description: Client-side JavaScript functions for managing shopping cart interactions, including adding, removing, updating items, and displaying mini cart summaries in an e-commerce web application.

methods.name: initMiniCart
methods.description: Initializes the mini cart display on page load.

methods.name: removeCart
methods.description: Removes the current shopping cart by clearing the cookie.

methods.name: initBindings
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for add to cart and open cart actions.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a product with specified SKU and attributes to the shopping cart via AJAX.

methods.name: removeLineItem
methods.description: Submits a form to remove a line item from the cart.

methods.name: updateLineItem
methods.description: Updates a specific line item in the cart via form submission.

methods.name: updateCart
methods.description: Updates quantities of multiple cart items via AJAX.

methods.name: displayMiniCart
methods.description: Fetches and displays the mini cart content.

methods.name: removeItemFromMinicart
methods.description: Removes an item from the mini cart via AJAX.

methods.name: displayMiniCartSummary
methods.description: Displays a summary of the mini cart based on cart code.

methods.name: viewShoppingCartPage
methods.description: Redirects to the full shopping cart page.

methods.name: displayShoppigCartItems
methods.description: Renders shopping cart items into a specified HTML div using Hogan template.

methods.name: displayTotals
methods.description: Displays cart totals or empties cart label if cart is empty.

methods.name: getCartCode
methods.description: Retrieves the current cart code from cookies if valid.

methods.name: buildCartCode
methods.description: Constructs a cart code string from store code and cart ID.

methods.name: saveCart
methods.description: Saves the cart code into cookies.
